messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(These are the federal holidays that fell on a Friday or a Monday, creating a three‑day weekend. Provincial holidays that create long weekends are not included – you’ll need to add those separately if you’re targeting a specific province.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------|-------|
| **Good Friday** | April 7 | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | May 20–22 (Mon–Wed) | Celebrates Queen Victoria’s birthday; observed in all provinces. |
| **Labour Day** | September 4 | Sep 2–4 (Mon–Wed) | First Monday in September; observed nationwide. |
| **Thanksgiving** | October 9 | Oct 7–9 (Mon–Wed) | Second Monday in October; observed nationwide. |
| **Remembrance Day** | November 11 | Nov 9–11 (Mon–Wed) | Observed in all provinces; some provinces give a statutory holiday on the nearest weekday if it falls on a weekend. |
| **Christmas** | December 25 | Dec 23–25 (Mon–Wed) | Christmas Day is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |

### Quick Summary

| Long Weekend | Dates (2023) |
|--------------|--------------|
| Good Friday | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | May 20–22 |
| Labour Day | Sep 2–4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 7–9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 9–11 |
| Christmas | Dec 23–25 |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to support provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), you’ll need to pull the holiday calendar for each province. Many provinces publish their holiday schedules online or via open‑data APIs. Once you have those, you can merge them with the federal list above to generate a complete long‑weekend calendar for any Canadian region.
